001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 11,
009    displayName = "Pumping Suspended",
010    internalName = "LID_PUMPING_SUSPENDED",
011    usedByTidepool = true
012)
013public class PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
014
015    private long preSuspendState;
016    private int insulinAmount;
017    private int reasonId;
018    private int rpaTimeout;
019
020    public PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog() {}
021    public PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long preSuspendState, int insulinAmount, int reasonId, int rpaTimeout) {
022        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
023        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, preSuspendState, insulinAmount, reasonId, rpaTimeout);
024        this.preSuspendState = preSuspendState;
025        this.insulinAmount = insulinAmount;
026        this.reasonId = reasonId;
027        this.rpaTimeout = rpaTimeout;
028
029    }
030
031    public PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog(long preSuspendState, int insulinAmount, int reasonId, int rpaTimeout) {
032        this(0, 0, preSuspendState, insulinAmount, reasonId, rpaTimeout);
033    }
034
035    public int typeId() {
036        return 11;
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * <table border="1">
041     * <caption>Parsed fields for PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog:</caption>
042     * <tr><td><code>preSuspendState</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
043     * <tr><td><code>insulinAmount</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
044     * <tr><td><code>reasonId</code></td><td><code>raw[16]</code></td></tr>
045     * <tr><td><code>rpaTimeout</code></td><td><code>raw[17]</code></td></tr>
046     * </table>
047     */
048    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
049        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
050        this.cargo = raw;
051        parseBase(raw);
052        this.preSuspendState = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
053        this.insulinAmount = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
054        this.reasonId = raw[16];
055        this.rpaTimeout = raw[17];
056
057    }
058
059    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long preSuspendState, int insulinAmount, int reason, int rpaTimeout) {
060        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
061            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(11, 0),
062            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
063            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
064            Bytes.toUint32(preSuspendState),
065            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(insulinAmount),
066            new byte[]{ (byte) reason, (byte) rpaTimeout }));
067    }
068
069    /**
070     * @return the state of the pump immediately before pumping was suspended
071     * (Tandem's pump-logs JSON calls this property preSuspendState)
072     */
073    public long getPreSuspendState() {
074        return preSuspendState;
075    }
076
077    /**
078     * @return an insulin reservoir quantity, in whole units, at the time pumping was suspended.
079     * This is NOT the IOB: the value is byte-identical in the paired suspended and resumed
080     * records which bracket a suspension, while the IOB the pump reports in LID_DAILY_BASAL
081     * over the same window decays.
082     *
083     * TODO: determine whether this is the insulin remaining in the reservoir or the current
084     * cartridge fill level. Observed captures support both readings and the question is
085     * unresolved: one suspend/resume pair drops 120 -> 105 across a 15 minute suspension
086     * (consistent with remaining volume being consumed by a tubing prime), while another
087     * capture reads 180 at a suspend roughly ten hours after a 180 unit cartridge fill
088     * (which remaining volume should have decremented by then).
089     */
090    public int getInsulinAmount() {
091        return insulinAmount;
092    }
093    public int getReasonId() {
094        return reasonId;
095    }
096    public SuspendReason getReason() {
097        return SuspendReason.fromId(reasonId);
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * @return the resume pump alert (RPA) timeout in minutes: how long the pump waits while
102     * suspended before alerting that insulin delivery is still stopped. 0 when unset.
103     * (Tandem's pump-logs JSON calls this property rpaTimeout)
104     */
105    public int getRpaTimeout() {
106        return rpaTimeout;
107    }
108
109    public enum SuspendReason {
110        USER_ABORTED(0),
111        ALARM(1),
112        MALFUNCTION(2),
113        AUTO_SUSPEND_PREDICTIVE_LOW_GLUCOSE(6),
114
115        ;
116        private final int id;
117        SuspendReason(int id) {
118            this.id = id;
119        }
120
121        static SuspendReason fromId(int id) {
122            for (SuspendReason r : values()) {
123                if (r.id == id) {
124                    return r;
125                }
126            }
127            return null;
128        }
129    }
130
131}
